messages:
zoe: Heads-up: post-launch sprint planning. We have 4 incoming signals: customer bugs (3), a UX polish, and analytics work to measure conversion. Need to pick focus for next 10 workdays.
matt: My preference is bug-first + analytics. If we don't measure conversion we won't know if the polish helps.
kevin: Engineering note: bug C is intermittent (race in session start). Fix might require tracing + slight infra change (~2d).
lia: From PM: two enterprise trials blocked by bug A. That should be prioritized.
zoe: Options: 1) Fix all bugs now + basic analytics; 2) Fix highest-priority bugs + full polish + analytics; 3) Hotfix one high-urgency bug, push others and polish to next wave.
matt: Lean 1. Or 3 if infra risk is high for some bugs.
kevin: Race condition has non-deterministic repro in staging. Recommend hotfix path for critical trials while we instrument tracing to root cause.
lia: We have customer commitments on A and C. If we do a hotfix for C, can we still deliver analytics?
zoe: We can include a lightweight analytics task: add feature flags + event for onboarding_complete so we can A/B the polish next sprint.
lia: That works. Decision: do hotfix for bug C to unblock trials, fix A and B during sprint, and land the lightweight analytics event for measurement.
kevin: I'll own the tracing and hotfix for C, will coordinate canary.
matt: I'll queue analytics events and a dashboard for conversion by mid-sprint.
zoe: Great. I'll update the roadmap and schedule a quick retro on the beta rollout after fixes land.
deploy-bot: Reminder: Canary window tonight 2024-04-05 22:00 UTC. Please submit change requests.
zoe: Closing thread after PRs.
